# So I Chose Web Application (app.soichose.com)

> Interactive zero-hindsight prospective decision clarity workspace. Sign in with passwordless Google authentication to lock Day-0 decisions with SHA-256 snapshots, build ANY/ALL branching outcome trees, view 6-axis Decision DNA reports, talk to 6 scoped AI companions, and export encrypted `.soichose` v2 backups.
